TC-21/S13.title: Custom template without a type cannot be saved; the type list (both contexts)
TC-21/S13.detail: Local 25acd727 (the type field is on main since 43c38a4f; 25acd727 adds the care-setting rule). Same run as TC-18/S09, one fresh account. 8/8 judged per both contexts: Settings -> New, name and instructions filled, no type, Save Template: the form stays open with 'Select a note type', no 'Could not save template'; after Close the template is in neither the Settings list nor templates:list. Type list: Hospital = H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note, Discharge summary, Procedure / other; Nursing Home = SNF admission, SNF follow-up, SNF consult, SNF discharge, Procedure / other; no Handoff, Clinic or removed template. Q11 recorded: each context offers only its own 4 types + Procedure / other (the case text says 'the 8 pilot types'); 25acd727 makes this the rule (518bb75c: a custom template's note type must fit its care setting).
